icc_local_selection.objective: F64 gated absolute MSE; mean layers, experts, sources

stages.purpose: Real clean video -> native encoding -> fresh forward noise -> CA1/CD2 per expert; no full CAL trajectory
5 arms x DEV11 x seed42; compatible artifacts deducted
2 sources; plain/ICC/Chip plus conditional Q1/GlobalP64 paths
Same selected CAL11 factors; reuse 4S parent outputs
Fixed selected family/rank/4S; preset local trigger only
stages.eligibility: selected main family in {CA_SVD, CD_SVD} and preset local trigger; if SVD, cap is zero

stages.purpose: At most one identified single-factor adaptation on DEV3
stages.selection: Before any main-video outputs: eligible legal nonequivalent changes only, fixed tail then precision priority; no eligible change means zero. Oracle mismatch must be fixed, not tested as an adaptation.

stages.calibration_unit: CA single call or indivisible CD pair; same operands/RNG, transactional statistics rollback
stages.purpose: One shared retry pool; no new source/seed/candidate

reuse: Deduct actual (source, seed, path, execution_id) only. Reusing all 11 Dense main slots requires valid reuse of the 2 mandatory hook paths too. Plain output cannot replace a missing hook execution; cancelled slots cannot be reallocated. Rollout-derived CA/CD statistics and factors do not qualify for author-style calibration reuse.
total_d4_cap_note: 77 only if all 3 shared retries are video; ICC calibration is counted separately, not included as D4.

retired_0e29_design.retired_component: 22 native-D4 CAL captures and rollout endpoint ICC calibration

icc_cal22_decision: One optional source-budget diagnostic; decision frozen before main-video outputs. E5 video trigger is evaluated only after CAL22 local scores exist.
